chunks: Mūsā ibn Bakr narrated from Zurārah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

“If a man sends his dog and forgets to mention Allah’s name, then he is like one who has slaughtered and forgotten to mention Allah’s name. Likewise, if he shoots and forgets to mention Allah’s name.”

key_terms.رَمَى: shot or cast, referring here to hunting with a weapon
key_terms.كَلْبَهُ: his dog, meaning the hunting dog
key_terms.يُسَمِّيَ: to mention the name of Allah at the act

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets to say the name of Allah when sending a hunting dog or shooting?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning hunting and slaughtering when the tasmiyah is forgotten. It states that forgetting to mention the name of Allah when sending a hunting dog or shooting is treated like forgetting it at the time of slaughter.
